name: De Lacey
quote: You respect me, and I'll give it in return.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Good morning, Professor. It makes me very happy to see you at the start of each new day!

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Oh, it's already afternoon. Would you like to have afternoon tea with me?

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: You've worked through the day, good work. Say... the view should be pretty good tonight, wanna come with me and have a look?

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: [System operation time has exceeded recommended limit.] (Pants) Oh! How embarrassing...

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: Ugh, why did Sammie have to leave...? Oh, Professor! Sorry, I'm rewatching my favorite movie. It's a love story between a human and an AI. Even though Sammie leaves Theo, I will never, ever leave you!

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: Oh, has some dust got into the jack on my tail? Don't worry, just blow on it for a bit and it'll be okay! Look... Hmm, this doesn't seem to work as well as the internet suggests.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Are you asleep? Heheh, the Professor can also have a cute side.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: Hmm... This equipment basically runs on the same principle as a Doll's body, right?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Ah... Haha...!

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Oh? Curious about my tail? That's a bit... odd.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Oh! P-Professor?!

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Leave it to me! I'll do my best to be of assistance to you!

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: I've been waiting for the day when I can fight by your side. I am De Lacey. Remember my name, Professor.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: For everyone's sake, I must work harder...!

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: Carry all your pain from the past and keep going forward. You're also prepared to do the same, aren't you, Professor?

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: I'll be able to save more friends with this? That's great.

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Where are we going this time, Professor?

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Attack!

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: I'll heal all your injuries!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: A textbook example of how to conduct a fight. Well done, Professor!

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: I worked really hard! Won't you praise me, Professor?

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: I can't stay with you till the end...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text:
Professor, have you ever thought about what you're living for? It's quite a tough question, isn't it?
Someone once asked me the same question, and I finally have an answer now—perhaps I was created to meet you.
Ah, this feels like a dream. The remainder of my life is now in your hands, Professor.

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: I'm so happy that I get to start this new year with you, Professor... Should I make a wish? Hmm, I wish... I can stay with the Professor in this coming year.

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text:
Happy Valentine's Day, Professor! I prepared this gift for you... In return, can I occupy your schedule for the day? What will we be doing? Hmm, just strolling around the Oasis, relaxing...
Or do you want to touch my tail?

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text:
I remember one Tanabata night some years ago, the stars were shimmering in the sky, but next to me was a beat-up Doll whose neural cloud was on the brink of death. The humans were already asleep, and I was surrounded by loneliness.
Thank goodness you're with me now, Professor.

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text:
"I am the Scorpion Queen from Evernight. I have taken over De Lacey's neural cloud on Halloween. If you wish to rescue her, then..."
Huh...? You fell for it? It... it was just a prank! Still... it makes me happy that you're so worried about me.

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text:
Professor, do you know any Christmas carols? If you don't, I'll teach you!
But if you do... then you should teach me, word by word, hehe! ❤

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text:
I've prepared this present ever since I found out your birthday. Now I finally get to hand it to you, I hope you'll like it...
In any case, thank you very much for your care all this time. Happy Birthday, Professor!

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text:
Uh, this? It's for linking up Dolls. Here, this connection port can be adapted to different Dolls and even connect multiple ones... Well, would you also like to try, Professor?
Hmm... It probably doesn't work on humans, but... let's plug you in and see?

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text:
It's been an honor to fight alongside you. Compared to what I expected, you are even more gentle, more dependable, more...
Oh no, my neural system is overheating! I need to go and calm down!

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
I have participated in numerous projects under horrendous conditions. They mostly took place in far-flung locations and would take a heavy toll on Dolls. The more extreme the conditions, the likelier it is for humans to treat Dolls as mere tools.
I kept vigil over Dolls who were on their last legs. They gripped my hand as if clinging to their only hope, but there was nothing I could do for them...
Back then, I vowed to myself that I would remember everything and keep moving forward, carrying all the pain and suffering I had witnessed.

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
I've seen too many Dolls living their whole life in misery. It got me thinking... Is this our fate...?
Sorry, this is quite a heavy subject, isn't it? But the fact is, not only are many Dolls living under terrible conditions, they are also treated unfairly. I want to do whatever I can to help them.
Professor, would you join me in my cause?

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
You've been working very hard all this while, Professor. You've done well getting us this far, but do try to rely a bit more on me from now on.
Would you like to rest your head on my lap for a while? Or how about a huuuuuuge hug?
Hmm, your body is so warm, I find that very reassuring.

voices.label: Understanding
voices.text: Oh~ I~ see~ now~

voices.label: Praise
voices.text: I think that's amazing!

voices.label: Sympathy
voices.text: I get it!

voices.label: Dissatisfied
voices.text: Hm…

voices.label: Laugh
voices.text: Hehe…Hahahahaha~

voices.label: Surprised
voices.text: Huh?

voices.label: Live2D
voices.text: Ah! P-Professor? ...Phew... Ahh... Eh?! This is awkward.

career:
The DMT-X series of dolls are Dolls jointly developed by a number of companies, led by Svarog Heavy Industries. It is dedicated to the maintenance and repair of other doll bodies.

Due to the harsh, high-risk working environment many dolls are subjected to, regular maintenance is required in order to prevent irreparable damage. This led to the creation of the DMT-X series. Through an agreement between the several enterprises, DMT-X dolls hold backdoor authorizations. In emergencies, they may even inspect the blueprints for any given doll without prior reporting and apply the proper repairs. DMT-X dolls can fix every model under every situation with lightning speed. In the most dire of situations, DMT-Xs can even manufacture ad-hoc component parts using various materials at hand so that the damaged doll has enough time to be evacuated for proper repair.

De Lacey was among the first batch of DMT-X dolls produced. She was chosen for Project Neural Cloud due to her outstanding work history and extensive experience.
infoStories:
After being put into use, most DMT-X dolls will be assigned to a specific task force as the resident doll medic. De Lacey, however, belonged to the R&D Director of the DMT-X series, shouldering the task of testing the latest features.

Whenever the R&D team wishes to implement an upgrade to the DMT-X series, they first test it out on De Lacey. Every conclusion that De Lacey comes to will determine the fate of the function in question for her fellow DMT-X dolls, which puts a tremendous amount of pressure on her. She does not, however, let the stress get to her.

Despite the fact she is often shifting between several different teams, De Lacey does not let it negatively affect her work. The opposite in fact, holds true with De Lacey using her utmost ability to offer clear and comprehensive explanations for every new function that is being tested. This has garnered her a large amount of respect amongst her peers.

One design aspect that separates the DMT-X series from ordinary repair dolls is their tail, which in actuality is a module composed of various hinges, mechanisms, and wires. It acts as a kind of adapter which allows them to jack into most doll models on the market and carry out intensive repairs as needed.

There is, however, a drawback to this design. The process of connecting to the body and analyzing it is rather invasive, and very few dolls have experienced such a high degree of physical contact. As a result, DMT-Xs are a very divisive subject amongst their fellow dolls. Those who value efficiency are very fond of them, whereas those who are more delicate detest them.

De Lacey operates differently, and is not rough when connecting to someone. Instead, she will first speak to the doll and establish an amicable relationship before starting the connection process. This shows how thoughtful De Lacey can be.

However, many dolls have seen that De Lacey seems to enjoy the physical contact that comes with the repair process...

This affinity for physical contact is not so much an embarrassing kink, but rather a way for her to leave an impression upon others.

Many of the dolls that DMT-Xs repair hold positions in hazardous industries, where one moment your colleague could be right beside you, and the next they're gone, taken away by a horrifying accident. De Lacey herself has experienced this all too many times before. De Lacey believes that every interaction with those around her will live on in her memories, for all eternity. A heartfelt handshake, a kind embrace... these are all ways for her to remember those moments.

—Nothing is permanent. All we can do is treasure the here and now.

De Lacey's work environment is often in a state of flux due to testing demands. She once encountered numerous dolls who were working in extremely poor conditions, yet were not treated with the accordant amount of respect. They were tools being used haphazardly, and tossed to the side once they had served their purpose.

De Lacey despises those who mistreat dolls, but she has not allowed this to color her view of all mankind. In fact, De Lacey has many human friends who treat dolls with nothing but respect, and she treats them in kind.

In this world where so much cannot be changed, De Lacey continually strives to help dolls fight for their rights and to repay the kindness shown to her by certain humans.

De Lacey once asked someone in private about the Professor. "The Prof was in charge of Project Neural Cloud, but ended up being uploaded into the Cloud to come to the dolls' rescue!" Hearing this story about the Professor piqued De Lacey's interest. Someone who valued dolls so highly was surely someone worth respecting.

As De Lacey heard more stories in the same vein, she started painting a picture of the Professor in her mind, which slowly became more vivid and exaggerated... De Lacey began to fantasize about one day being able to work together with the Professor.

"If more people in this world respected dolls like the Professor did, then perhaps it wouldn't be such a miserable place."
oathDesc: Connecting to and healing her beloved.

projections.name: Doll Maintainer
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"To soothe the defect on a Doll's body as well as the pain in their heart. This is the duty of us maintainers."

projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"To soothe the defect on a Doll's body as well as the pain in their heart. This is the duty of us maintainers."

projections.name: Master of Construct
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"Do you need me, Professor? Call my name and I will be there for you, whenever it is, wherever you are."

skinList.name: Pollen Pulse
skinList.desc:
From the "Sweet Secrets" series — a leisure outfit made to meet daily needs, so you and your Dolls can enjoy a sweet moment together.
"Hurry up and lie down, there's only the two of us here. Hm... I have so, so many things to say, and I want to take my time saying them to you."

skinList.name: Fool's Duality
skinList.desc:
The Dolls reveal their true natures by accident, and take new forms with the aid of a mysterious power. Where truth and falsehood intersect, beware of drowning in a fool's game.
"Hehe... Such adorable poses you're in. Let me be your personal prototyper, Professor~"

skinList.name: Romantic Day of Destiny
skinList.desc:
From the "Silhouettes Under Firework Blossoms" series — Tailored by a renowned craftsman and filled with the feeling of summer.
You meet De Lacey in the temple that's aglow with lantern light, and the fragrance of caramel and apples lingers near her lips.
"To think I'd run into you here. It seems we really are meant to be together~ Now then, would you like a taste of a candied apple?"

skinList.name: Heartfelt Projection
skinList.desc:
A scene that transcribes you and me into 1s and 0s, separated by nothing more than a processor cycle. This ripple within our neural clouds is a memory that can never be reset.
"There are other ways for us to feel each other besides a data cable connection. Would you like to try them out with me, Professor?"
skinList.photoName: Heartfelt House of Cocoa - De Lacey

skinList.name: Faraway Hotline
skinList.desc: The surging fighting spirit that swells between each intense battle is what keeps each Doll going until the very end. Whether it's on the attack or defense, their memories have been reproduced in Magrasea through this projection, no matter how good or bad the situation is. "Pro-Pro-Pro-Professor?! I'm so sorry you had to see me in this disheveled state... Could you help tend my wounds, please? Don't tell anyone else, okay..."
